items.title: Butch Cage and Robert Pete Williams Interview, 1967-05-13
items.q: Dane Jackson lived up there on Mr. Albert Mills' place up there in Plains.

ctx.x: Somebody's coming. We can, we can wait. Okay. I'm not going to turn it off again for nothing. Okay, let's see. You know, I wanted to ask you about guitar players from Bethel, uh, from Ethel and Baker and all these different places when you were growing up.

Well, uh, when I was growing up and following up these places, uh, the best guitar players that I have known in music, uh, take for Butcher, he used to play a guitar too, Phil, but he was the best and, uh, his brother Fred and, uh, Dane Jackson. Dane Jackson was great with a guitar. And dude Morgan. Uh, to my remembers, I think that was the best I heard. No more than the others that I heard that's grab a guitar and sing a little here and jump where we are, you know. And so, but I think these men's here was the…
